Cinnamon_Tree_Sapling_description: Takes 28 days to produce a mature Cinnamon tree. Harvest the bark in the Fall. Only grows if the 8 surrounding "tiles" are empty.
Lemon_Tree_Sapling_description: Takes 28 days to produce a mature Lemon tree. Bears fruit in the Fall. Only grows if the 8 surrounding "tiles" are empty.
Black_Pepper_Vine_Starter_description: Plant this starter in Spring. Takes 17 days to mature, and continues to produce after first harvest.
Vanilla_Vine_Starter_description: Plant this starter in the Summer or Fall. Takes 23 days to mature, and continues to produce after first harvest.
Basil_Seeds_description: Plant these seeds in the Summer. Takes 11 days to grow.
Cardamom_Seeds_description: Plant these in the fall. Takes all season to grow. Can be processed into Cardamom in a Mill.
Coriander_Seeds_description: Plant these seeds in the Fall. Takes 10 days to grow. Used as a spice throughout the world.
Cumin_Seeds_description: Plant these seeds in the Summer. Takes all season to grow. Can be processed into Cumin in a Mill.
Mustard_Seeds_description: Plant these seeds in Winter. Takes 12 days to grow. Place 5 into a Preserves Jar with wine to make Dijon Mustard
Oregano_Seeds_description: Plant these seeds in the Spring. Takes 12 days to grow.
Soybean_Seeds_description: Plant these seeds in the Summer. Takes 12 days to grow.
Turmeric_Root_description: Plant these in the Summer. Takes all season to grow. Can be ground into Turmeric in a Mill.
Cinnamon_Bark_description: Unprocessed bark of the Cinnamon tree. Grind this into Cinnamon in a Mill.
Pepper_Drupe_Spike_description: A cluster of Black Pepper Drupes. Place these in a Dehydrator to make black pepper.
Vanilla_Pod_description: A fresh Vanilla Pod. Place these in a Dehydrator to get valuable Dried Vanilla Beans.
Basil_Leaves_description: Leaves from a basil plant. Can be used on their own, or made into Basil in a Dehydrator.
Coriander_Stalk_description: A stalk of the coriander plant. Worth splitting into Coriander Leaves and Seeds by hand.
Oregano_Leaves_Description: Leaves from the oregano plant. Can be used as a spice, or made into Oregano in a Dehydrator.
Soybean_description: A bean with a subtle Umami Flavor. Place this in a Preserves Jar with wheat to make Soy Sauce.
Cinnamon_description: A widely used spice produced from the bark of the Cinnamon tree.
Dried_Vanilla_Bean_description: The world's second most expensive spice. Make Vanilla Extract with this in the kitchen.
Basil_description: An herb used in cuisines worldwide.
Cardamom_description: This pricey spice is widely used in various cuisines.
Coriander_description: The leaves of the coriander plant, used in cooking throughout the world.
Cumin_description: Used as a seasoning both whole and ground, this spice is made from the seeds of the Cumin plant.
Oregano_description: An herb used worldwide, especially alongside Tomatoes.
Turmeric_description: A ground spice used in many cuisines across the world.
Vanilla_Extract_description: Liquid vanilla, used in all sorts of recipies.
Dijon_Mustard_description: A rich yellow condiment, produced right here in Stardew Valley!
Soy_Sauce_description: A fermented liquid condiment known for its saltiness and umami flavor.
Tofu_description: Solidified Soy Milk, a common source of plant-based protein.
Edamame_description: A popular plant-based food with a sweet, nutty flavor.
Deviled_Egg_description: A decadent take on the classic hard boiled egg.
Cinnamon_Roll_description: A sweet roll made with Cinnamon.
